title: GraphQL Resolver Module Compiler
description: Compiles GraphQL resolvers. Enforces: N+1 guarded by DataLoader/batching, no direct DB access in resolvers (service layer only), authorization checked per resolver, error mapped to GraphQL errors (not raw exceptions), no circular resolver calls.

error_codes.GR002: graphql-schema-artifact.json not found — compile schema first
error_codes.GR003: Direct DB access (prisma/db) in resolver — use service layer
error_codes.GR004: List resolver has no DataLoader or batch loading pattern
error_codes.GR005: Resolver missing authorization check (no context.user, no guard)
error_codes.GR006: Non-GraphQL error thrown from resolver (raw Error instead of GraphQLError)
